contents.name: Theorem 2.7.2 (balance of Tor)
contents.reason: The theorem balances the two derived tensor constructions, not the Hom constructions; preserving its proof here would duplicate the designated Tor development.

contents.name: Application 2.7.8 (external product for Tor)
contents.reason: This constructs the external product on Tor from tensor-resolution comparisons; Ext’s Yoneda product is instead developed on the following Yoneda extensions page.

contents.reason: These are coherence obligations for the Tor external product and require the tensor-product construction not included in the present Ext balance proof.
